+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def collect_platform_metadata(prompt: str, model: str = "gpt-5.4-mini") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    response = client.responses.create(model=model, input=prompt)
+    output_text = getattr(response, "output_text", None)
+    if output_text is None:
+        chunks = []
+        for item in getattr(response, "output", []) or []:
+            for content in getattr(item, "content", []) or []:
+                text = getattr(content, "text", None)
+                if text:
+                    chunks.append(text)
+        output_text = "".join(chunks)
+    usage = getattr(response, "usage", None)
+    metadata = {
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": model,
+        "model_handle": getattr(response, "model", model),
+        "resource_id": getattr(response, "id", None),
+        "usage": {
+            "input_tokens": getattr(usage, "input_tokens", None) if usage else None,
+            "output_tokens": getattr(usage, "output_tokens", None) if usage else None,
+            "total_tokens": getattr(usage, "total_tokens", None) if usage else None,
+        },
+    }
+    return {"output": output_text, "metadata": metadata}
+
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: select_platform_resource.py
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class OpenAIPlatformResource:
+    model: str
+    api_base: str = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
+
+
+def select_platform_resource(preferred: Optional[str] = None) -> OpenAIPlatformResource:
+    model = preferred or os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL") or "gpt-4.1-mini"
+    if not model.strip():
+        model = "gpt-4.1-mini"
+    if model.startswith("openai/"):
+        model = model.split("/", 1)[1]
+    return OpenAIPlatformResource(model=model)
+
*** End Patch
